_comment: Display settings of the burst-selection diagnostics, moved out of the main toolbar (which was full, and holds actions rather than settings). Binds to BurstDisplayViewModel, which proxies to the tool's own widgets so nothing is duplicated.

sections.label: All photons
sections.description: Show the diagnostic layers computed from every photon in the range.

sections.label: Selected photons
sections.description: Show the diagnostic layers computed from the photons the burst search kept.

sections.label: First photon
sections.description: First photon index to process. 0 is the start of the file.

sections.label: Last photon
sections.description: Last photon index to process. The default is the end of the file.
